chapter: Films, Las Vegas and the union
title: St. Louis Blues film, 1958
summary: Willard reads the cast list of the Handy biopic with Nat Cole and Callender names Nelson Riddle.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: I guess! Then your other film that is listed is St. Louis Blues in 1958.
That was the story of W.C. Handy, right?
And Nat Cole had the title role.

Right. And it also features Pearl Bailey, Cab Calloway, Mahalia Jackson, Ella Fitzgerald, Barney Bigard, Teddy Buckner, Red Callender, Curtis Counce, Lee Young, and Billy Preston as the boy W.C. Handy, music arranged and conducted by Nelson Riddle.
Right. So you worked with Barney on several pictures, right?
